ownerRule: Only the current summon owner being an Ascended Druid selects the ascended appearance. Never use the viewer or another party member.
event: summon_end includes appearanceKey, ownerId, abilityId, targetId, x, y and died; a cosmetic endpoint, never an authoritative live animal
liveAscension: Existing animals update their form on the next state response without re-spawning.
travelRecovery: Travel/restart dismiss live summons under existing rules and retain recharge. A subsequent summon derives the current owner's form. No saved appearance field is required.
artOwnership: Sprites chat supplies final distinct animal variants and dispatches the client presentation. Stable normal art remains usable while those exports are under review.
artStatus: pending visual chat integration and in-game review
